issues: shot-01 has an infeasible performance/contact handoff: Bot’s right hand releases the elevated teal roof at local frame 175 and contacts history-engage-control at frame 177, despite the control being far below the roof. No registered reach transition or alternate-hand grip supports that two-frame relocation. Use the already-free left hand with a real registered anchor, release the roof earlier, or delay engagement and impact.

shot-02’s stated after-state is not supported by its events: it says the retained roof’s trail is connected to the empty live slots, but the only terminal connection is paper-gold-history-strip to write-drive-rack at frame 38. Rewrite the before/after/consequence around the actual rack connection or add an explicit anchored slot connection.

shot-05 does not provide a finite developing floor-sag action. The wet mask completes over frames 31–37, while frame 37 is already declared as the sag stop and the affine rule says bending occurs after the wet mask. That leaves the consequential deformation effectively instantaneous. Add separate sag start and stop frames before the recognition hold.

shot-07 contains mutually contradictory exit timing. The physical sequence and exit_overlap place Bot’s departure at frames 64–69, before the lever contact at 79 and release at 85; the offscreen event is at 89 but its affine rule still specifies frames 64–69. Move all departure references to one post-release interval within frames 89–99.

Shots 04 and 08 declare a physical environment but resize the persistent house to 0.72/0.73 while the tabletop remains fixed. A display carriage can translate a paper object but cannot physically shrink it; the independent roof rails further expose the unsupported transform. Replace scaling with a justified camera/depth operation, a genuinely folding reduced representation, or choose and justify minimal-isolated staging.

The character-response intentions in shots 01 and 05 exceed their registered performance declarations. Their energy fields require focused-to-surprised and focused-to-worried transitions, while the capability routes declare only the terminal canonical states surprised and worried. Bind the transitions through supported high-energy-paper performance phases or simplify the intended acting to the single registered state.
